MULTIROTOR.label: Multirotor
MULTIROTOR.cue: Dense, regular vertical flashes from several rotors around a body line.

FIXED_WING.label: Fixed-wing / propeller
FIXED_WING.cue: A strong steady body line with fainter periodic propeller flashes.

BIRD.label: Bird
BIRD.cue: A slow ripple (2-10 Hz wingbeat) close to the body line; no blade flashes.

HELICOPTER.label: Helicopter
HELICOPTER.cue: Few, very wide flashes from long main-rotor blades.
